name: Umbral Ruin

civilization.name: The Penumbral Concordance
civilization.notes: A once-expansive interstellar civilization that mastered shadow-frequency communications across dozens of systems. Their final war, the Dimming, lasted only eleven hours but rendered the planet's biosphere irreversibly sterile through cascading antimatter detonations. Skeletal arcologies still pierce the dust plains, their crystal lattice walls fused into opaque black glass.

geological_features: Vitrified crater basins spanning hundreds of kilometers
Collapsed subsurface transit tunnels forming labyrinthine sinkholes
Irradiated salt flats with faintly luminescent mineral deposits
specific_features: The Dimming Scars — continent-scale blast shadows burned into exposed bedrock
Frozen communication spires still emitting faint subspace static
Mass grave-vaults sealed beneath magnetized rubble fields
resources: Penumbral data-cores embedded in arcology ruins
description: Umbral Ruin is a world stripped to its bones. Vast plains of calcium-white dust stretch between the blackened stumps of arcologies, their shattered spires rising like broken teeth against a perpetually hazy sky. The thin atmosphere carries a metallic tang, and static discharge crackles across the surface during the long, frigid nights.

There is a silence here that feels deliberate, as though the planet itself is holding its breath. Wind moans through the fused crystal corridors of dead cities, producing harmonic tones that early survey teams mistook for active transmissions. The light is weak and diffuse, filtered through particulate layers that have not settled in millennia.

The Penumbral Concordance ruled from this world for over nine thousand years, threading shadow-frequency relays between star systems like a nervous system of dark light. Their civil war, known only as the Dimming, ended everything in less than half a day — antimatter salvos crisscrossed the globe until nothing lived. What triggered the conflict remains unknown; their data-cores are encrypted in a language that shifts with each decryption attempt.

Salvage crews and xenoarchaeologists circle Umbral Ruin like moths around a dead flame. The Concordance's technology, even ruined, commands staggering prices on black markets and in research institutions alike. But the planet resists easy plunder — its irradiated zones shift unpredictably, and more than one expedition has reported hearing coordinated harmonic tones that seem to track their movements through the ruins.
